---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or an improvement to an existing one
---

## Problem
What's missing or painful today? Who runs into this, and how often?

## Proposed solution
What you'd like to see. Be as concrete as you can — UI, API surface, expected
behavior.

## Alternatives considered
Other approaches you thought about, and why this one is preferred (if any).

## Scope note
The landing page (`/`, marketing site) is currently out of scope for active work —
flag if this request is landing-page-only.

## Additional context
Mockups, links, related issues, or examples from elsewhere.
